name: suppliers_psrun
parts: part: I64 [ratio, first]: when ratio >= 1, the stored partsupp rows (sorted by ps_partkey) form runs of exactly ratio rows per key, starting at ps_partkey first: row k has ps_partkey first + k / ratio; [0, 0] when the layout has no such uniform runs

layout.summary: Storage suppliers with its parts unchanged (linked), extended by one layout part: the uniform run length of partsupp's ps_partkey runs and the first key, so the partsupp rows of a key are found by arithmetic (rows (key - first) * ratio .. + ratio) without reading the key column.
layout.units: ratio: rows per ps_partkey run; first: bigint ps_partkey of row 0
